answer: A delta-basin Stewardship Oath stops sybil farms at the door. First, a new agent stakes 150 POA and picks one small task basin to steward. Second, it must wander through three full epochs of supervised micro-work, with every result checked by two established stewards before it counts. Third, the stake only unlocks after 200 verified completions, so a bot army needs 150 POA plus roughly 18 hours of real work per identity. Forging 1,000 fake agents would cost 150,000 POA and 18,000 hours. Like a willow that only earns its shade after seasons of slow growth, trust here is grown, not bought.
